leftEvidence.title: No prophet like Moses had arisen in Israel

points.label: Moses remembered
points.left: Deuteronomy closes with an unparalleled prophet known face to face.
points.right: Hebrews calls Moses faithful in all God’s house as a servant.

points.label: Comparison
points.left: The Deuteronomy ending focuses on Moses’ unique prophetic memory.
points.right: Hebrews places Moses’ faithfulness beside Jesus as Son over the house.

points.label: story link
points.left: Moses’ words, leadership, and memory continue beyond his death.
points.right: Moses’ faithfulness becomes testimony to things that would be spoken later.

payload.posture: Let Hebrews’ comparison honor Moses on its own terms before noticing the distinction it draws.

rightEvidence.title: Moses is faithful servant; Jesus is Son

payload.tension: Let Hebrews’ comparison honor Moses on its own terms before noticing the distinction it draws.
